instruction: From the home page, use the navigation bar to go to the Routes page. How many routes are listed?
Go to the Stops page and search for stops containing the word 'Main' using the search bar. How many stops are found?
Find all transit stops within 1 km of latitude 47.2510 and longitude -122.4390 using the nearby stops API. How many stops are within that radius?
Use the Trip Planner to plan a trip from 'Maple Ln' to 'Harbor Marina' with the 'fastest' preference. How many route options are returned?

Plan a trip from 'Lakeport Transit Center' to 'Innovation Way Campus' using the Trip Planner. Select the 'cheapest' route preference using the radio button. What is the fare for the first option shown?
Navigate to the detail page for Route 1 (Downtown - Harbor). What is the estimated travel time in minutes?
Plan a trip from 'Lakeport Transit Center' to 'Seattle King Street Station' for a Sunday. How many route options are available on that day?
On the Routes page, use the route type radio buttons to filter for only 'express' routes. How many express routes are shown?
On the Routes page, sort the routes by travel time. What is the name of the first route in the sorted list?
Search for stops on the Stops page using the query 'Oak'. What is the name of the first stop in the results?
On the Fares page, use the zone dropdown to select Zone A and the rider dropdown to select 'adult'. What is the single ride fare shown?
Look at the schedule for Route 1 (Downtown - Harbor). What is the first departure time from Lakeport Transit Center on the outbound timetable?
Use the fare calculator API to compute the fare for a youth (6-18) monthly pass in Zone B. What is the fare amount?
Which route has the shortest estimated travel time among all routes? Report the route name and travel time.
Compare Route 1 (Downtown - Harbor) and Route 6X (Express to Seattle) using the Compare Routes page. What is the travel time difference between them in minutes?
On the Stops page, use the zone dropdown to select Zone B. How many stops are in Zone B?
Rank all routes by peak frequency (most frequent first). What is the name of the 2nd most frequent route?
Which route has the longest estimated travel time? Report the route name.
Export all routes data as CSV using the export feature. How many data rows (not counting the header) are in the exported CSV?
Share Route 1 (Downtown - Harbor) via a link using the share feature. What is the generated share URL path?
